Name: Fish On Hook Preview
Author: abroalmor
Description:
Description
Fish On Hook Preview displays the icon of the currently hooked fish above the fishing bar.
By default, fish you have never caught before are hidden behind “???” to preserve the surprise of discovering a new species. Once you successfully catch that fish, its icon will be shown during future encounters.

Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod.[/*]
[*]Place the entire FishOnHookPreview folder inside your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Main features
• Displays the currently hooked fish above the fishing bar.
• Optionally hides uncaught fish behind “???”.
• Updates automatically after you catch a new fish.
• Automatically supports modded fish that use Stardew Valley 1.6’s standard item system and the vanilla fishing minigame.
• Works with different UI scale settings.
• Includes configurable icon size, position, background, and spoiler behavior.
• No additional framework mods are required.

Configuration
A config.json file will be created after the first launch.

ShowQuestionMarkForUncaughtFish
• true: Uncaught fish are displayed as “???”.
• false: All hooked fish icons are displayed.

IconScale
• Controls the size of the fish icon.
• Accepted range: 0.5 to 2.0.
• Default: 1.0.

VerticalOffset
• Controls the vertical distance between the icon and the fishing bar.
• Default: 8.

ShowBackground
• Controls whether a dark background panel is displayed behind the icon.
• Default: true.

Compatibility
Modded fish are detected automatically when they are registered through Stardew Valley 1.6’s standard item system and use the vanilla fishing minigame.
Mods that completely replace the vanilla fishing minigame may not be supported.

Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
